primary.chain_difference: phase-reweighted Q4 mean minus phase-reweighted Q1 mean within the same independent chain
primary.estimate: equal-weight mean of the four chain differences; report pooled complex ratio contrast as a consistency comparison
primary.stderr: sample standard deviation of four paired chain differences divided by sqrt(4)
primary.interval: two-sided 95% Student t with df=3; chain, not block, is the independent replicate
primary.small_sample_caveat: t interval assumes approximately normal independent chain contrasts; only four chains, no distribution-free coverage claim
primary.readiness: consider T=6.4 only if primary interval supports small change and phase/numerics are sound; positive replication and unresolved intervals are reported separately

auxiliary: existing six-observable half/quarter/between-chain and 100/200/400 blocking; no per-diagnostic 3-sigma veto
historical: 7101-7104 separate descriptive comparison using the same chain-replicate method; no pooling with new data
stop: exactly four chains; no outcome-dependent additions, budget changes or T=6.4 in this job
